patterns.note: Full-width sections with content constrained to a central max-width container, often using a dark background with contrasting light text.
A dominant dark green/teal (#224944) paired with a vibrant, almost neon, accent green (#26e986) and occasional orange (#e95f26) for CTAs, creating a sophisticated yet energetic feel.

The navigation bar transforms from transparent to a solid dark green background and slightly shrinks in height after scrolling past the hero section, becoming sticky at the top. Sections reveal with a subtle slide-up and fade-in effect as they enter the viewport.
Feature and platform displays utilize a grid of card-like elements with subtle rounded corners and internal padding, often on a dark background.

technique_notes: The hero section uses a fixed or slowly parallaxing background graphic while foreground content scrolls over it, creating depth. Subsequent sections are revealed with a staggered fade-up and slight upward translation as they enter the viewport. The main navigation bar dynamically changes its background color and height upon scroll, transitioning from transparent to a solid, darker background to maintain contrast and prominence.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold sans-serif headings (hero ~3-4x body, section headings ~2x body) with clear, readable body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (e.g., 4-8px) on buttons, cards, and input fields, providing a soft modern feel without being overly playful.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within card layouts, creating a sense of openness and reducing visual clutter.

standout: The distinctive dark green/teal and bright neon green color palette creates a sophisticated yet energetic feel, effectively using a dark mode aesthetic with strategic pops of color and clean typography to present complex financial information in an approachable and modern way.
